result.headline: Human Written
result.prediction: We believe that this entire text is human-written.
result.text:
I’ve learned to get nervous when somebody knows too much about me too soon. We’re twin flames. She knows my motives. I’m Lord Krishna. Okay, maybe I really am way better than the other guys she’s found. But if she hasn’t found anything about me that bothers her yet, she hasn’t found all of me.
I still love women I loved before her. Sometimes I talk about them because I’m thinking about them. I’m not trying to make her jealous. If she can’t handle that I still love them, she isn’t ready for me. She can ask me, “Can you talk less about your exes?” Sure. Maybe I do. But if I’m expected to hear everything on her mind while I have to pretend this isn’t on mine, that’s different.
